title: Signal: pip configuration trusts a host without TLS verification
scope: A pip.conf file that declares a `trusted-host` entry, for which certificate validation is skipped.
limitations: It matches a `trusted-host` entry, for which certificate validation is skipped in the parsed pip.conf; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A pip.conf that mentions a `trusted-host` entry, for which certificate validation is skipped in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
